cache.description: Whether to cache the pnpm store directory

cache_dependency_path.description: File path to the pnpm lockfile, which contents hash will be used as a cache key

package_json_file.description: File path to the package.json to read "packageManager" configuration. This path must be relative to the repository root (GITHUB_WORKSPACE).

standalone.description: When set to true, @pnpm/exe, which is a Node.js bundled package, will be installed, enabling using pnpm without Node.js.
